snippet.title: MOBU - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Become a superpowered monk in MOBU, a fast-paced roguelite arena shooter where chaos escalates and builds can break the game.

Fight waves of bouncing enemies raining from the sky, choose powerful upgrades, and create absurdly strong synergies to survive as long as possible.

---

🎮 Play the demo on itch.io:
https://saidera-studio.itch.io/mobu-demo

👉 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4404580/MOBU/

---

🎵 Music:
"Dark Alleys" by Blonde Hawk 

---
